tool.name: Atlas

param.name: input_image
param.label: The input image path. The width and height of the image should be even for best results.
param.help: The input image path. The width and height of the image should be even for best results.

param.name: gaussian_std
param.label: Standard deviation of the Gaussian window (0 for global threshold).
param.help: Standard deviation of the Gaussian window (0 for global threshold).

param.name: p_value
param.label: P-value to account for the probability of false detection.
param.help: P-value to account for the probability of false detection.

param.name: area_lim
param.label: Remove detections smaller than this area.
param.help: Remove detections smaller than this area.

tool.help: ATLAS is a new spot detection method. The spots size is automatically selected and the detection threshold adapts to the local image dynamics.
